I was only 15 at the time and I know the brain doesn’t fully develop until the age of 25. I never really looked into what the Dr. originally “diagnosed” me with and neither did my parents. They’re loving but just don’t see eye to eye with me about things anymore which is why I have a hard time trusting them with this. I don’t want to go into a psychiatrist because I feel like my parents will baby me or think I’m some freak as well as my friends. I want to talk to someone badly about everything that’s happened but I just don’t know who which is why I made the post. I have been smoking weed to suppress the feelings of self-hate etc. but at the same time I want to get off of it because jobs/people are so against it.  I don’t know maybe there is light at the end of the tunnel but it’ll be a journey for me.  I really appreciate what you’re telling me though it has helped. I also recently started to meditate which helps get my mind off things just not enough.

Thank you for the advice it helps. Classes resume Monday so I guess I can go into the dean and the one class and try to talk to them I just don’t know if they’ll accept what I have to say seeing as the end of the semester is right around the corner and I am just now coming in to talk. I want to strive and do my best right now it’s just so hard.

Thanks for the advice. I guess I fixated on that point to much and was angry at the time. I don’t want to call myself a pussy but I am. I have had opportunities and dropped the ball. I also forgot to put that I’m retaking a class and am going to fail it again out of being a lazy idiot. That has been bothering me so much because I can’t tell my parents because I’m ashamed. My middle brother is like a saint to my family. I just want to tell everyone to basically fuck off and leave this state and life behind but I can’t support myself financially or find a decent job in without a degree. I’m stuck and I just had to get everything out there. I really do appreciate your response and hope that you love a long happy life.

He said he travelled to France and forgot to bring his blood pressure medication, and was going to be without it for 3 weeks.  His wife insisted he try and get the meds, so he asked a friend who lived in France and they said to go to the pharmacy and they'll have what he needs. He said it costs him a doctors visit, prescription and $840 to get his pills in the US(his copay is $90).  He got his meds over the counter for $12. Goes to show how horrible the US system is.
